Unmodified upstream assets and Git blob SHA-1:
src/stockfish-nnue-16-single.js: a65eee4cc480f3b9306815109a6aac8be298bad6
src/stockfish-nnue-16-single.wasm: 68a9e278be2b7413584e7c0237833f0faa9cac5e

The application sets Use NNUE=false to use Stockfish 16's built-in classical
evaluation without downloading an external neural network. cli.cjs is a local
adapter for Node.js data preparation; the browser loads the upstream JS directly.

These assets are vendored so development and builds need no engine download.
They were obtained from the official upstream repository, not a third-party mirror.
